info.title: Starburst Enterprise
info.description: Starburst Enterprise is a self-hosted, Trino-based analytics platform for querying and governing data across catalogs. Its REST API manages built-in access control (roles, grants, role assignments), data products, ad hoc/scheduled SQL jobs, and cluster maintenance windows.

servers.description: Starburst Enterprise coordinator. This platform does not apply OpenAPI server variables/paths automatically — set the integration instance's server.base_path to "/api".

host.description: Starburst Enterprise coordinator hostname or IP.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Built-in access control roles, which bundle privileges and are assigned to users and groups.

tags.name: Grants
tags.description: Privilege grants that attach a role to an action on a catalog, schema, table, column, or other entity.

tags.name: LocationGrants
tags.description: Read/write privilege grants scoped to a storage location pattern rather than a catalog entity.

tags.name: Subjects
tags.description: Role assignments to and from users and groups.

tags.name: RoleAssignments
tags.description: Read-only view across all role assignments.

tags.name: Domains
tags.description: Data domains used to group and govern related data products.

tags.name: DataProducts
tags.description: Curated, published collections of views over one or more catalogs.

tags.name: Workflows
tags.description: Asynchronous data product lifecycle actions (publish, delete).

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Free-text tags applied to data products.

tags.name: SqlJobs
tags.description: Ad hoc or scheduled SQL statement execution.

entityId.description: Identifier of the catalog/schema/table/column/role/function/procedure entity the privilege applies to.

grantOption.description: Whether the grantee can re-grant this privilege to others.

locationPattern.description: Storage location or glob pattern this grant applies to, e.g. s3://bucket/prefix/*.

definitionQuery.description: SQL SELECT statement backing the view.

catalogName.description: Target catalog the data product's views are published into.

schemaName.description: Target schema the data product's views are published into.

domainId.description: Data domain the data product belongs to.

cron.description: Cron expression controlling when the job runs.

sqlStatements.description: One or more SQL statements executed in sequence when the job runs.

cronSchedule.description: Cron expression controlling when the maintenance window opens.

durationMinutes.description: Length of the maintenance window in minutes.

expression.description: SQL boolean (row filter) or scalar (column mask) expression.

entityId.description: Column entity the mask applies to.
Table entity the row filter applies to.

name.description: Name for the cloned data product.

definition.description: Exported data product definition, as returned by the export endpoints.

domainId.description: Domain the listed data products are reassigned to.
